sources.label: Community app patches by BadFella.
sources.author: BadFella
patch_list: Disables swiping between the D-pad or touchpad and number pad. Keeps the switch button and setup page swipes. Requires Remote ATV ad-free. Supports version 6.1.0, build 45.
Disables advertising, restores startup and replaces premium activation with a local ad-free status. Removes the home banner and its spacing. Does not create a server subscription.
